title: Hello, Biology! Introduce Yourself and Your Field
objective: Students start using English to introduce themselves, biology interests, and simple study goals.
outcomes: Greet classmates and a teacher politely.
Introduce name, year, field, and biology interest.
Use simple sentences with be, study, like, and interested in.
activity: Introduce yourself. Ask about one thing your partner says.
example: Two students meet before a biology lab. One says: “I am interested in DNA because it explains how living things pass traits to their offspring.”
